def rank(rows):
    m = [[F(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    r = 0
    cols = len(m[0])
    for c in range(cols):
        p = None
        for i in range(r, len(m)):

                break
        if p is None:
            continue
        m[r], m[p] = m[p], m[r]
        for i in range(len(m)):

                f = m[i][c] / m[r][c]
                m[i] = [a - f * b for a, b in zip(m[i], m[r])]
        r += 1
    return r
